title: Zesty Egyptian Chinese Broccoli Bowl
description: A creamy, low-glycemic bowl featuring Chinese broccoli tossed in a tangy Egyptian-inspired sauce, served in a sizzling stone bowl.
instructions: Preheat a stone bowl (dolsot) over medium heat until steaming hot.
Season the chicken thighs with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then sear them in olive oil until golden brown on both sides, about 4 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken and set aside, reserving the drippings in the bowl.
Add minced garlic and ginger to the bowl, sautéing until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in tahini, rice vinegar, low-sodium soy sauce, and sriracha, whisking until the mixture turns silky.
Return the chicken to the bowl, spooning the sauce over it, and reduce heat to low.
Add the Chinese broccoli, sprinkle with lemon juice, and cover the bowl with a lid or foil.
Let the dish steam until the broccoli is tender-crisp and the sauce has thickened, about 6 minutes.
Flip the chicken and broccoli to ensure even coating, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer the bowl to the table, garnish with toasted sesame seeds and a drizzle of extra olive oil, and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
